priority_race.description: The priority race selected from the Intervals.icu calendar (normalized_snapshot.races). Never taken from athlete_state, the profile or other local memory.

race_recommendations.description: Optional tune-up / fitness-test race suggestions. Each item: type (tune_up | fitness_test), for_race, suggested_distance, ideal_window, enhancement_rationale, covered_by, covered_by_days_to_race.

b_c_race_handling.description: Mini-taper and post-race easy days for B/C races in or near the week.

info.description: Neutral notes, e.g. profile races that are not on the Intervals calendar.
